built.by: P. Valerius, suspected of aiming at kingship for building on the top of the Velia, had his house pulled down and rebuilt at the foot of the hill (Livy 2.7.5-12; Plut. Publicola 10; Cic. Rep. 2.53)

monuments.english: House of P. Valerius Publicola below the Velia

monuments.owner: P. Valerius Publicola and the Valerii

ended.what: pulled down after Sp. Cassius was condemned for aiming at kingship; the site left open before the temple of Tellus (Livy 2.41.11; Dion. Hal. 8.79.3)
